name: Neural Network Pruning for NeRF
aliases: Neural Network Pruning for 3D Scene Compression
definition: A 3D compression method that reduces the storage size and inference time of a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) by removing weights with the smallest magnitudes from the fully-connected neural network representing the scene.
summary: Neural Network Pruning for NeRF compresses 3D scenes by removing small MLP weights to reduce storage and inference time, distinguished by its unstructured magnitude pruning rather than structural changes.
